properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation to restrict sensitive data access to authorized users and systems with strong authentication
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to confirm that only authorized users and systems can access sensitive data, enforced through strong authentication, least privilege, and segregation of duties.
